requirements.evidence: Contract covered: Entity with HasFactory/SoftDeletes, getRouteKeyName()='slug', memberships()/users()/owner() (app/Models/Entity.php:22-60); EntityMembership with UserRole cast and owner/admin/employee scopes (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:89-118); UserRole::manageable() returns [Admin, Employee] (app/Models/UserRole.php:198-201); User::memberships/entities/membershipFor (app/Models/User.php:157-175); factories with states (database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:369-388); migrations with named unique indexes and stored generated owner_seq + entity_memberships_one_owner (database/migrations/..._create_entity_memberships_table.php:442-446). Policies match the rules, including owner membership never deletable and self-removal (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:232-246). Correctness is not demonstrated by any test (e.g. the generated-column expression on SQLite), and docs ER diagram names the column `owner_seq_null` instead of `owner_seq` (docs/database-schema.md:493).

conventions.evidence: Conventions require 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test' — the diff adds no test files. CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] not updated. Migration names `2026_10_29_000001_...`/`000002_...` look hand-written rather than generated by make:migration. Positives: $fillable set deliberately (Entity.php:24-27, EntityMembership.php:83-87), authorization in app/Policies, docs/database-schema.md updated to drop owner_membership_id.

security.evidence: Policies deny non-members everywhere (membershipFor(...) !== null checks in EntityPolicy.php:277-297 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:221-245); manageSettings owner-only (EntityPolicy.php:297); owner membership can never be deleted (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:234-236); strict in_array comparisons with enum cases; $fillable defined on both new models; DB-level single-owner invariant. No routes or UI added, so no input surface.

tests.evidence: No tests/ files in change.diff at all: no tests for the one-owner unique index, slug uniqueness, cascades, scopes, factories, or any policy allow/deny path, despite the project's mandatory TDD rule.

simplicity.evidence: Lean models and policies; EntityPolicy::delete reuses update (EntityPolicy.php:288-291). Minor duplication of the 'owner or admin of this entity' check in three places (EntityPolicy.php:282-285, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:226-229 and 242-245) and an unnecessary dual enum/string comparison in isOwner (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:250-251).

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, PHPDoc generics consistent with Laravel style. isOwner compares against both `UserRole::Owner` and `UserRole::Owner->value` although role is cast, which is confusing dead logic (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:250-251). Docs ER label `owner_seq_null` is misleading (docs/database-schema.md:493).

scope.evidence: Everything serves the task; no routes, pages, session or middleware added. Docs change also removes the `locale_default` column from the proposed entities schema (docs/database-schema.md:473), which the task did not ask for.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests for the migrations' constraints (single owner, unique membership, slug), factories, scopes or any policy allow/deny path, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] was not updated as the docs-in-sync convention requires.
Sequential 000001/000002 timestamps suggest the migrations were hand-written instead of created with php artisan make:migration.
ER diagram documents the column as `owner_seq_null` instead of the actual `owner_seq`.
isOwner compares to both the enum and its string value although role is cast to UserRole; the string branch is dead and inconsistent with the other policy checks.
The 'owner or admin of the entity' check is duplicated across both policies instead of a small shared helper (e.g. on EntityMembership or User).
Removes the proposed `locale_default` column from the entities schema doc, which is unrelated to this task.

review.summary: The change adds the entities/entity_memberships migrations (with the stored generated owner_seq single-owner index), the Entity/EntityMembership models, UserRole enum, factories, both policies and updates the schema doc; the implementation matches the contract and authorization rules closely. However, it ships no tests at all despite the project's mandatory TDD convention and skips the CHANGELOG, so it needs changes before merging.
